title: Stopped by Straż Miejska (City Guards)
question: What can Straż Miejska do and what are my obligations when stopped?
short_answer: Straż Miejska (city guards) have limited powers compared to police. They can check your identity only in connection with a violation and issue fines for minor offences.
conditions: Can check your identity only if you are suspected of a violation
Can issue fines (mandaty) for: littering, parking violations, noise, drinking alcohol in public
Must show their badge (legitymacja) upon request
Cannot arrest or detain you — only police can do that
Cannot search your bags or belongings
Can call police if you refuse to cooperate
exceptions: Cannot stop you on the street without a specific reason (suspected violation)
In some cities Straż Miejska has expanded powers — check local regulations
You can refuse to show documents if no violation is suspected — but this may escalate the situation
penalties: Refusing to pay a fine on the spot: case sent to court, fine may be higher
You can appeal any fine within 7 days
